title: PURPOSE asks whether Anthropic's trust can hold through an IPO — 'a trust that has its own “sunset time” built in from the very start'
summary: The steward-ownership nonprofit published an analysis of the ownership and governance structure Anthropic is taking into its IPO, reading the Long-Term Benefit Trust and the Public Benefit Fund against the pull the book names. A shorter version ran on ImpactAlpha. Anthropic is one of the companies the book itself examines.
blockquote: Can a trust that has its own "sunset time" built in from the very start really protect the mission from the dynamics of the global financial markets and their "financial gravity" (thanks Eric Ries for that razor-sharp term)?
